title: is either slash, or either one percent-encoded in either case
why: A percent-encoded backslash no longer a separator: a Windows path in a file URL would not end a word, and a home written that way would not be found.

title: matches the text exactly
why: A full stop and brackets left unescaped: a path's "a.b" would match "aXb", and "(x86)" would be a group.
